article_require_review.label: Require review before publish
article_require_review.help: ON: an editor's article must be approved by an admin before publishing. Admin-authored articles skip review.

article_allow_slug_edit.label: Allow manual slug editing
article_allow_slug_edit.help: ON: type the slug, duplicates are rejected. OFF: the system derives the slug and auto-suffixes on collision.

publish_allow_now.help: ON: immediate publish only (scheduling hidden). OFF: also offer “Scheduled” (pick a time) — immediate publish still allowed.

newsletter_notify.help: Email newsletter subscribers when an article is published.

ai.title: AI assistant
ai.subtitle: Configure the website assistant, watch what it costs, and grant agents access.

field.enabled_hint: Off → the site falls back to the scripted bot without showing visitors an error.
field.provider_hint: Pick OpenAI-compatible for Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, Groq or OpenAI itself.
field.base_url_hint: Empty → the provider's default. Point it at your own host to run a local model.
field.api_key_set: Set — type a new value to replace it
field.api_key_hint: Stored encrypted and never readable again. Leave blank to keep the current key. Local endpoints usually need none.
field.persona_hint: This is ADDED to the standing brief. The safety rules (no pricing, no legal advice) always apply and cannot be edited here.
field.daily_cap_hint: Past the cap the assistant falls back to the scripted bot. 0 disables the cap.

test.costs: Costs a few tokens per click.
test.passed: Connected, and the model calls tools.
test.no_tools: Reached the endpoint, but the model did NOT call the tool. The assistant would answer from imagination instead of the catalog — choose another model.

usage.near_cap: Close to the cap. Hitting it drops the assistant to scripted replies.
